1._section_summary: This section describes the statistical analyses conducted on a single study with samples from three countries (Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden), including both boys and girls (N=1012 total: 79 Danish girls, 50 Danish boys, 296 Portuguese girls, 217 Portuguese boys, 155 Swedish girls, 215 Swedish boys). After removing 124 participants with missing data, 1012 observations (89% of the original sample) were retained for analysis. 1._section_summary: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 among adolescents and young adults across three countries: Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden. The study found that the BAS-2 has a single-factor structure across all three countries and both sexes, with partial scalar invariance across countries and between genders. Results showed that body appreciation is positively associated with self-esteem, psychological well-being, and intuitive eating, though the relationship with BMI varied by country (negative in Portugal, non-significant in Denmark and Sweden).
